note: SC-14/A4b (F-86) — pins the legacy YELLOW band, which no fixture reached. ctm = COLLAPSE_ENTROPY_THRESHOLD - 0.18 = 0.15, so CTM_YELLOW (0.1) < ctm <= CTM_LOW (0.2) and computeCTM takes the `if (ctm > CTM_YELLOW)` return. The sibling legacy-yellow-zone.json is named for this band but its entropy of 0.25 gives ctm 0.08, which falls through to the RED band — so guard-ablation's `drift-sentinel:guard-off:#22` survived: deleting the yellow rule changed no frozen expectation. Entropy is held flat so gradient_alert stays false and the case pins the band alone. Reverting the rule flips zone yellow -> red and risk_level medium -> high.
